growth.unavailable: The growth record could not be read.
growth.eggHint: Not measured yet — {{needed}} more answered check-in(s) to go.
growth.tripwireBlocked: Accuracy has reached the line, but {{count}} action(s) were refused for safety recently. Until those fall out of the recent window it does not become a butterfly — a safety refusal is not averaged away.
growth.byTaskTypeHint: A new kind of work starts in its own egg instead of dragging the overall number down.
growth.calibrationGood: When it says how sure it is, that number is worth reading — it has been about as right as it claimed, across {{count}} answer(s).
growth.calibrationPoor: How sure it says it is does not track how often it is right yet ({{count}} answer(s)). Read the recommendation, not its confidence.
growth.askQuality: Of the times it asked, {{warranted}} of {{asked}} turned out to be worth asking. It acted alone {{silent}} time(s) without needing a fix, and {{missed}} time(s) you had to correct it.
growth.recent: What it asked, and what you chose
growth.recentCorrected: you answered in your own words: {{text}}
growth.howItMoves: This does not rise with the number of conversations or stored memories. It moves when naby asks how to proceed and its own recommendation turns out to match what you chose — and, counting for much less, when something it did without asking was looked back over later and you had left it alone. It can fall when your patterns change.

meaning.egg: Still watching. It has asked too few times for its record to mean anything yet.
meaning.larva: Being measured now, but it is not guessing right often yet. Too early to hand work over.
meaning.pupa: It guesses right fairly often. A little more and you can call on it.
meaning.butterfly: You can now address it with @ and hand it work.

reason.notMeasured: There is not enough to judge yet. Answer {{needed}} more check-in(s) and the stage starts being calculated.
reason.newPattern: A kind of work it had not seen before came up. {{misses}} of the last {{trials}} went differently from what it expected, mostly on "{{taskType}}" — it is still learning that one, so the stage came down.
reason.accuracyDrop: On familiar work, {{misses}} of the last {{trials}} went differently from what it expected. If how you decide has shifted, a few more answers bring it back in line.
reason.accuracyGain: Its recommendations landed more often lately — only {{misses}} of the last {{trials}} went differently.
reason.evidenceGrew: It is right about as often as before, but you have answered more, so the estimate is firmer. This rose because the evidence grew, not because it got better.
reason.steady: Recent decisions look much like the earlier ones.

excluded.one-real-option: the options were not really different
excluded.repeat-question: the same question had just been asked

growth.implicitAxis: It also acted on its own {{reviewed}} time(s) that were looked back over afterwards, and you left {{stood}} of them alone. Those count toward the gauge too, but each is worth {{weight}} of a check-in you actually answered — not objecting is weaker evidence than choosing.
